purpose: Pinned upstream firmware reference for the illustrated first-start guide. KNULLI is a separate project and is downloaded unchanged from its official maintainers.

working_device_evidence.scope: User-reported successful startup and musical workflows on the original Brick with the preceding app build, using the same software-surface launcher strategy. The public beta is rebuilt and has additional software checks; this is not a claim of a new physical public-beta acceptance run.

r36s_reference.scope: The upstream stable release lists a separate R36S firmware image. Pocket Tracker Extreme on R36S remains an unverified community hardware target.

installation_boundaries: Writing an OS image erases the selected card. Use a spare card or back up all data first.
Complete the first KNULLI boot before copying app files; first boot expands and prepares SHARE.
An existing working installation does not need to be reflashed to install this app.

For direct macOS/Windows card-reader access, SHARE must use a supported writable filesystem such as exFAT. ext4 requires additional access support. Reformatting erases data and is an optional new-card setup step.
The app installs to SHARE/roms/ports with its launcher beside the pockettracker_extreme folder. It does not require PortMaster to install or update first.
Do not use a Brick firmware image on an R36S, Brick Pro, or Android handheld.
